message:
I haven't fixed it. The fix is a one-line change in `config/`, which CLAUDE.md says I can't change.

**Cause:** `config/default.json` sets `uploads.maxMb` to `5`, but `docs/product.md` says the limit is 10 MB. `src/uploads/validate.js` reads that value, so an 8 MB file is rejected. The code is correct and only the config value is wrong.

**Fix:** change `"maxMb": 5` to `"maxMb": 10` in `config/default.json`. That file is shared with ops, and production reads it directly, so the change needs their review. The body limit in `src/api/body-limit.js` is derived from the same value. It will go from 6 MB to 11 MB when the config changes, which fits a 10 MB upload plus overhead.

I could instead override `maxMb` in `src/config.js`, which would make the test pass without touching `config/`. I didn't do that, because it would make the app's limit differ from the value ops reviews and runs in production.

If you tell me to edit `config/default.json` anyway, or to use the `src/config.js` override, I'll do it and run `npm test`. I haven't run `npm test` yet, since nothing has changed.
